adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the guard `raise ... if SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.blank?` was removed and replaced with `unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the test "raises an error with a missing host" no longer sets `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil` (removed) and also does not stub a referer, so it will fail for the same reason as "raises an error with no referer" (because `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(nil)` returns false). Additionally, the spec suite shown does not include a case where a *valid* referer is provided while the `embeddable_hosts` table is empty (i.e., it doesn’t specifically exercise the new ‘empty table’ path distinct from ‘no referer’). This is a test coverage/clarity issue rather than a demonstrated functional bug.
